Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study compares the proteome of extracellular vesicles (EVs) released by cells intoxicated with two different pore-forming toxins (LLO and PLY) against non-intoxicated controls and serum-starved controls. While the toxins are bacterial in origin, they are used here as purified chemical/protein agents to induce PM damage, mapping to cytotoxic/poison treatment. Serum starvation is a secondary control variable.
